what_this_is: Regulatory and assurance sources crosswalked against stable goal objects, so a source changing state does not invalidate the map.
what_this_is_not: Not a statement of what any law requires. A goal is a question we can gather observable evidence against, never a legal conclusion.
Not a compliance determination. CSOAI measures and never certifies, so no goal ever resolves to compliant or non-compliant.
Not exhaustive. Goals are added when a source raises a question no existing goal can carry, and the addition is recorded.

verification_states_explained.PRIMARY_SOURCE_FETCHED: We retrieved the primary artifact ourselves.
verification_states_explained.PRIMARY_ARTIFACT_FETCHED_DEADLINE_FROM_S: We hold the artifact, but a date on the row is not stated in it.
verification_states_explained.REPORTED_BY_SECONDARY_SOURCES: We have not retrieved a primary artifact. Anything published from such a row must say so.

totals.coverage_note: NO_SOURCE means no source in this crosswalk raises that goal. It does not mean the goal is satisfied, and it does not mean no such source exists in the world.

deadlines.provenance: NOT_IN_PRIMARY_ARTIFACT. We fetched the RFC file and the alliance homepage on 17 September 2026 and neither states a closing date. sources.name: CFTC Innovation Task Force

verification.quoted_scope: develop a clear regulatory framework for innovators focused on crypto assets and blockchain technologies; artificial intelligence and autonomous systems; and prediction markets and event contracts

sources.why_this_source_matters_most_to_us: It is the only source in this crosswalk whose stated scope covers crypto and blockchain AND artificial intelligence and autonomous systems in one mandate. That intersection is where our measurement work already sits.

sources.name: CLARITY / Senate digital asset market structure text
sources.effective_state_note: The Senate cloture vote on the motion to proceed failed 49 to 50 on 15 September 2026, eleven short of the 60 required. The Senate never reached debate, so no vote was taken on the bill's contents. STALLED is a statement about procedure, not about the merits, and not a prediction.

verification.note: The vote count and date come from press reporting, not from a Senate roll-call record we retrieved ourselves. Anything published from this row must say so until the roll call is fetched.

sources.why_still_indexed_though_stalled: The goals this text raises did not vanish with the vote. Three other sources in this crosswalk address the same goals and remain operative. That is the whole reason the crosswalk is anchored to goals rather than to section numbers.

sources.name: GENIUS Act implementation: FDIC prudential framework for permitted payment stablecoin issuers

verification.quoted_scope: a prudential framework for FDIC-supervised permitted payment stablecoin issuers, including requirements related to reserve assets, redemption, capital, and risk management standards
verification.deadline_provenance: NOT_COMPUTABLE_FROM_PRIMARY. The release states only that comments are accepted for 60 days after Federal Register publication, and does not give that publication date. We do not carry a deadline we cannot compute from a source we fetched. The Federal Register itself refused our request, so the date stays absent rather than guessed.
verification.note: The underlying Act and the Federal Register text were NOT retrieved. This row covers the FDIC release only, and nothing here should be read as describing the statute.
